newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek police fire teargas to stop Athens jailbreak.
newsitem.headline: Greek police fire teargas to stop Athens jailbreak.

text.p: Greek riot police fired dozens of rounds of teargas to prevent an attempted mass jaibreak from an Athens maximum security prison on Friday but there were no reports of injuries, police said.
They said hundreds of mainly Albanian prisoners refused to return to their cells at Korydallos prison west of Athens and tried to escape.

"The escape attempt was planned. Guards found ropes with hooks which were to be used by inmates to climb the prison walls. There were no escapes and the situation will be soon under control," a police official said.
He said riot police units were stationed around the prison awaiting orders to storm it if necessary.
